features.name: PCI DSS Compliance Implementation
features.description: Maintain PCI DSS compliance with minimal scope through hosted payment pages, tokenization, encryption, and audit logging

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want to maintain PCI DSS compliance with minimal scope, so that customer payment data is protected and regulatory requirements are met.
acceptanceCriteria: System never stores full credit card numbers or CVV codes
Uses hosted payment pages or tokenization for all card transactions
Encrypts all payment-related data in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher
Implements strong access controls for payment system administration
Maintains audit logs of payment activities for at least 12 months
Completes appropriate Self-Assessment Questionnaire (SAQ A or SAQ A-EP) annually
Conducts quarterly vulnerability scans by approved scanning vendors
Implements role-based access controls for cardholder data
Documents all payment processing workflows and security controls
Maintains Attestation of Compliance (AOC) for acquiring bank submission

features.name: Super-App Compliance and Governance
features.description: Maintain compliance with WeChat and Grab platform policies including approval processes, certifications, and policy monitoring

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want to maintain compliance with super-app platform policies, so that the integration remains active and avoids suspension.
acceptanceCriteria: Complies with WeChat Mini-Program guidelines
Complies with Grab Partner program policies
Submits updates for platform approval before deployment
Maintains required certifications and licenses
Responds to platform policy changes within required timeframes
Implements required security measures per platform standards
Maintains data privacy per platform requirements
Handles platform API deprecations proactively
Monitors platform status and announcements
Documents compliance procedures and audit trails
